grammar.1.title: deshalb / deswegen: verb in 2nd position
grammar.1.text: deshalb is an adverb — not a subordinate clause. At the start of a sentence the subject comes after the verb.
grammar.2.title: weil / deshalb — the difference
grammar.2.note: Both matter for A2. Besides deshalb: „darum, deswegen, daher“ are almost the same.
